description: Find x402-paid APIs by subject in the public x402 index (the Bazaar published by the CDP facilitator). Returns resources with their method, price and chain, re-priced from this client's own registry. Listings are sellers' own words. Nothing is paid; follow up with quote_x402 or pay_x402.

chain_id.description: Only resources payable on this chain

offset.description: Index offset to continue from (use next_offset from the previous call)

query.description: Words that must all appear in the resource URL, service name, description or tags (case-insensitive)

name: discover_x402
